rows.title: Range Intelligent Computing medium-term notes issued in the interbank market (bonds payable at 2026-09-30)
rows.detail: The Q3 report says bonds payable of RMB 994,631,400.41 (none at end-2025) are mainly from medium-term notes issued in the interbank market during the period; long-term borrowings rose 42.43% to RMB 18,719,334,800.00 and long-term payables 65.48% to RMB 7,313,689,979.40 as financing grew with compute-equipment investment. Issue date not stated; dated the report's disclosure day. Amount as stated: bonds payable RMB 994,631,400.41 at 2026-09-30.
